verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a Developer Sandbox that replicates core v2 API functionality using test funds. It supports mocking flows and executing transfers, funding USD and Paxos stablecoins via the Dashboard, and depositing testnet faucet assets for end-to-end testing. Coverage of payouts and conversions is only implied by the 'core v2 API functionality' claim, and nothing documents deterministic test values. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox coverage of payouts/fiat withdrawals and conversions, documented deterministic test values or magic amounts for simulating outcomes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rehearse everything without real funds — a documented sandbox or testnet mode covering payments, payouts, and conversions with test values that behave deterministically

citations.quote: The Developer Sandbox replicates core v2 API functionality with an automated system that uses test funds to simulate normal activities
Use the Sandbox environment to mock flows, execute transfers and test integrations.
the Dashboard **Fund** button support **USD and Paxos-issued stablecoins only** (USDP, PAXG, PYUSD, USDG).
Source test crypto assets from faucets and deposit them into your Sandbox account for end-to-end integration testing.
